fusions.name: Cross-Stitch Salvo
fusions.desc: Fires 3 rounds that each deal 6 damage, each with a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Weighted Lead
fusions.desc: Deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and adds 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Haul Line
fusions.desc: Pulls a line of snare 6 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Trailing Weights
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, a bolt leaps to the nearest other enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
